note: Which version of the method made each stored run. The tag is bumped when the method changes in a way that can change results (lib/experiment.ts PIPELINE). 7 published runs were made on 2026-11-02a; every other record keeps the tag it was made with, and the pages show it. Records made on 1 to 2 November before the bump carry 2026-10-27c, although parts of the round-12 and round-13 changes were already in the code that made them (see madeWith). Written by scripts/pipelines.ts from the stored records.

versions.changes: The method as benchmarked: sealed held-out 30%, noise-normalised ranking with ties to the simpler law (BIC in fixed steps of 2), clock check, ruler and stated-length uncertainties.

Rounds 12 to 14. Round 12 (commit 1811071, 2 Nov 01:00 IST): the flight-window seal never fits a held-out frame; pendulum lengths held when stated or measured; the pivot gate; square pixels. Round 13 (f6da584, 04:20 IST): ties never break on a law's id; the pivot gate skips the frame-diagonal rule for a far pivot straight above the swing; a short toss is fitted from its take-off; the clock check says when g was held. Round 14: the take-off is the first frame in flight (it kept one or two rest frames); the pages say a BIC decided a tie only when it is lower by 2 or more (the ranking itself is unchanged).
